name: barometer
description: Context and plan-limit gauges in the band above the prompt

redLine1M.title: Context red line, 1M windows
redLine1M.description: Context % where the bar turns red and the Compact button appears; 0 turns it off

redLine200k.title: Context red line, 200k windows
redLine200k.description: Context % where the bar turns red and the Compact button appears; 0 turns it off

alwaysShowCompact.title: Always show the Compact button
alwaysShowCompact.description: Show it whenever no reply is running, not only once context reaches the red line
